title: Add Service uses the inline add pattern; no canned lines offers Mark complete
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. On a row whose service carries canned lines, use Add Service and confirm it is the existing inline add pattern, identical on every row.
  2. Confirm Add Service is available even on services not yet due (that carry canned lines).
  3. On a service with no canned lines, confirm it offers Mark complete alone, in the row's menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Add Service uses the existing inline add pattern, identical on every row.
  • Add Service is available on every row whose service carries canned lines, including services not yet due.
  • A service with no canned lines offers Mark complete alone, in the row's menu.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R8: “Add Service uses the existing inline add pattern, identical on every row”
  • S16-R9: “Add Service is available on every row whose service carries canned lines, including services not yet due. A service with no canned lines offers Mark complete alone, in the row's menu”
